deprecated_camera_last_motion.description:
The `{entity_id}` ({entity_name}) camera entity is deprecated and has been replaced by the **Last motion** image entity on the same device, which shows the same still image and updates the moment a motion event fires. The image entity relies on the DoorBird calling Home Assistant, so make sure the events are set up as described in the [integration documentation]({docs_url}).

Update any dashboards, templates, automations or scripts to use the image entity, then disable `{entity_id}` and it is removed automatically on the next restart or reload of the integration.
deprecated_camera_last_motion.title: The DoorBird last motion camera is deprecated

data_description.events:
Add a comma-separated event name for each event you wish to track. After entering them here, use the DoorBird app to assign them to a specific event.

Example: somebody_pressed_the_button, motion
